title: Decide on banning strategy - let Better Auth manage or separate model
description:
We need both systems:
1. Better Auth admin plugin banning - for security issues (credential abuse, etc)
2. Platform suspend system - for HOA violations, non-payment, etc. (separate from auth)

Our current User model has banned/banReason/banExpires which conflicts with Better Auth's admin plugin expectations.

Solution: Remove the custom ban fields from User model, let Better Auth handle auth-level banning, and keep a separate "suspension" system for platform-level admin (different use case, different fields needed like suspensionReason, suspensionType, etc.)

title: Fix Better Auth admin plugin conflict with custom User schema
description:
Status: Admin plugin works in standalone Node.js script but fails in Next.js API routes with 'Failed to create user'. Other plugins work fine.

Tested:
- Node.js script: signup works with admin plugin
- Next.js API route: signup fails with admin plugin
- Other plugins (2FA, org, bearer, passkey): all work in both contexts

Root cause: Likely a bundling/module issue with Next.js/turbopack

Temporary workaround: Admin plugin disabled, auth works with other plugins.

Would need deeper investigation or help from Better Auth community.
